aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.imgDescription: An photo of my self with two shaddows of the same picture, one in red and the other one in blue
aboutMe.paragraphOne: My name is Vinicius, and I am a Front-End Developer with over four years of hands-on experience building, maintaining, and supporting web applications using technologies such as React, Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
aboutMe.paragraphTwo: I have contributed to projects across different industries, including real estate, retail, oil and gas, financial and banking, and military systems, with a focus on responsive design, performance optimization, and scalable UI architecture. I also have experience with automated testing, version control, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices, contributing to code quality and reliable deployments.
aboutMe.paragraphThree: In addition to my development experience, I am a Technology Instructor with a background in teaching web development and other IT-related subjects, covering everything from fundamental concepts to industry best practices.
aboutMe.paragraphFour: I have experience delivering both in-person and online classes, as well as creating technology courses and educational content focused on software development and professional soft skills.

education.graduation: Degree in Analysis and Software Development

projects.coffeDeliveryDescription: An application for managing a shopping cart for a fictional coffee shop. The project was built with React and other libraries.
projects.igniteShopDescription: An application that simulates a T-shirt store. It includes a Stripe integration to handle the payment process.
projects.githubBlogDescription: An application that displays issues from a specific repository, along with some profile information from a GitHub user.
projects.designSystemDescription: An application designed to document a design system using Storybook and a monorepo architecture.
projects.meguieDescription: A mobile application developed using Android Studio and Java, following the guidelines of the UN Sustainable Development Goal 8.
projects.musicplayerDescription: An application featuring layouts for a music player. The main focus of the project was the alignment of HTML elements within a web page.

projects.bookDescription: Contribution to an article about Prompt Engineering for the book *Tecnologias do Amanhã*.
projects.channelDescription: A YouTube channel focused on sharing knowledge and personal experiences in the IT field, mainly for new students.
projects.instructorDescription: Teaching online classes about soft skills and the job market for the social project Escola da Nuvem.

projects.exchangeDescription: A cultural and educational exchange in New Zealand to improve my English language skills. I stayed in New Zealand for nine months.
projects.gardeningDescription: Volunteering involving gardening, painting, repairs, and planting activities, combined with environmental awareness.
projects.housekeepingDescription: Volunteering as a housekeeper at a hostel, where we shared tasks, experiences, and conversations.
